digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 41
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Ravensworth Proxy adds adaptive timeouts
items.summary: Ravensworth Proxy adds adaptive timeouts that follow the recent latency of each backend. Timeout decisions are written to an audit stream for later review.
items.whyItMatters: Slow backends stop holding up requests.

items.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
items.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file.

items.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
items.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has.
items.whyItMatters: Runaway tasks stop on their own.

sources.title: Ravensworth Proxy adds adaptive timeouts
sources.summary: Ravensworth Proxy adds adaptive timeouts that follow the recent latency of each backend. Timeouts never go below a floor set in config. Operators can pin a timeout per route.

sources.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
sources.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file. Sampling decisions are written to an audit stream for later review.

sources.title: Lornwick Agents add tool call budgets
sources.summary: Lornwick Agents add budgets that cap how many tool calls one task may make. A task that hits its budget stops and returns what it has. Budgets can be set per team in the admin console.
